A '''textile droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. It operated as an automated sewing machine.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The textile droid had only a brief mention in [[1987]] in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|First Edition core rulebook]] of [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] of [[West End Games]], designed by [[Greg Costikyan]].
